Baby FAQ.

Short answers. Tiny drama.

What is PONS BABY?＋

A 10,000-piece collectible NFT series featuring tiny baby characters with signature house-shaped heads and different outfits, themes and personalities.

How many are there?＋

The collection supply is 10,000 NFTs, numbered from #00001 to #10000.

Where can I mint?＋

The official PONS BABY collection is available on OpenSea. Use the official buttons on this website to visit the collection.

When will my PONS BABY be revealed?＋

Instant reveal will begin once 100% of the collection has been minted. Until the mint is fully completed, NFTs will remain unrevealed.

What happens after the mint is completed?＋

After 100% of the collection is minted and the reveal is complete, the PONS BABY website will be upgraded with a full gallery, rarity explorer, collection statistics, character browsing, holder-focused features, and Roadmap V2 updates.
